colourByHolding.note: Bright variants are for dark grounds only (DS v2 §3.4 accent law applies to charts unchanged).

evidenceEncoding.note: A number without an evidence state does not get drawn.

grounds.note: Radius/elevation from DS v2 §5 tokens; no component hard-codes a colour.

name: viz-tokens
source: Design-upgrade pack DESIGN-POLISH.md §4.1 (~/workspace/your_files/design-upgrade-2026-11/), derived from Design System v2 (~/workspace/your_files/design-system-2026-11/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md §3.4, §3.5, §4.2, §5). Exported for SwarmTriage in maintenance rotation M3; every other surface consumes this same file so sites, dashboards and the 3D universe draw from one palette.

status.note: Status colour is ALWAYS paired with a text label; colour is never the only channel (DS v2 §3.5). Full dark-ground set lives in DS v2 §3.5.

vizBars.referenceImplementation: SwarmTriage decision panel (this app): horizontal probability bars, value in mono, label in sans, threshold tick at the rule value with the rule text beside the panel.
vizBars.scales: 0-1 scales always drawn full-width (no truncated axes); counts use a stated baseline.

thresholds.note: Not a probability bar: fires on category = grant AND urgency score >= 2. Shown as choice/score rows, never drawn as a 0-1 bar.
thresholds.question: urgency
